A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{inline_data_media: "DropElement"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
